name: Heartseed of the Unbroken Green
discovery_condition: Found beneath a living root arch after returning a stolen name to its rightful bearer.

name: Ashen Moon Pear
permanent_benefit: +1 on saving throws against charm effects created by Fey.
discovery_condition: Harvested before sunrise with an iron-free blade and eaten before its skin darkens.

name: Salt-Crown Oyster
permanent_benefit: +1 on saving throws against forced movement caused by water, wind, or waves.
discovery_condition: Recovered from a wreck whose registry insists it never sailed.

name: Bellroot of the Silent Physician
permanent_benefit: +1 on Medicine checks made to identify poison or disease.
discovery_condition: Located by reconstructing the physician’s rounds from unpaid household ledgers.

name: Starfall Grain
permanent_benefit: Whenever you spend one or more Hit Dice during a Short Rest, regain 1 additional Hit Point.
discovery_condition: Separated from the glass without breaking a kernel and ground under open night sky.

name: Last Loaf of Saint Othmar
permanent_benefit: +1 on saving throws against fear caused by Undead.
discovery_condition: Granted only after proving that a shrine’s official relic is counterfeit without causing a public riot.

name: Emberhorn Marrow Pearl
discovery_condition: Recovered without killing the beast, then simmered for a full day in a miner’s rescue kettle.

name: Memoryless Plum Preserve
permanent_benefit: +1 on History checks concerning vanished civilisations.
discovery_condition: Found in an impossible pantry behind a sealed tax archive.

name: Gravewinter Tea
permanent_benefit: +1 on saving throws against magical sleep.
discovery_condition: Obtained from the last mourner who still knows which grave produced the leaves.

name: Black Glass Honey
discovery_condition: Collected without smoke and sealed before touching worked metal.
